title: Yellow Vests and citizens protest living costs and education in Grenoble

tea.why: Protesters oppose ten years of authoritarian capitalism, social aid cuts, and climate inaction.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the end of the Parcoursup selection system, 10 billion euros for schools and universities, and price freezes on energy and basic food…
tea.changed: Nov 12: Gilets Jaunes de Crolles and local groups called for a fifth inter-struggle protest starting at Grenoble station.

summary: Demonstrators in Grenoble prepared for a new inter-struggle mobilization on November 14, 2026, marking the fifth act of ongoing social protests in the city. Initiated by the Gilets Jaunes of Crolles alongside high school students, university students, unions, and climate activists, the march was scheduled to begin at the Grenoble railway station at 14:00 and head toward Mistral Park. Participants organized to contest living costs, social aid reductions, and climate policy, while demanding increased funding for education and price caps on basic goods. According to media reports, previous weekends of protests involved clashes, property damage, and numerous police detentions since mid-October.
demands: 10 billion for high schools and universities
Price freeze on energy and basic foods
response: No official response reported in the sources.

arrests.text: 137 placements in garde à vue between October 17 and November 9

updates.text: Organizers announced a new Saturday protest starting at the Grenoble railway station.
